title: room.promoted
description: server → client. Tells a pending spectator that it is now a full player. Sent when a vote round opens (before the electorate is fixed) or a new mission starts, while a slot is free; pending players are promoted in join order. The token stays valid; the SpectatorId is retired. room.state and roles.state follow for everyone.

roles.description: Roles received through rebalancing (see Role rules); may be empty before roles lock.

PlayerId.description: Player identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "p" followed by a positive integer (p1, p2, …).

RoleId.description: Mission Control role (§3.3), in canonical order.
